title: Complete-state Laya representation-budget sweep
scope: Preprocessing representation experiment followed, only if a budget is selected, by one bounded local optimizer smoke; no policy training or evaluation
hypothesis: Increasing the complete-state Laya representation budget reduces label-conditioned representability bias enough to satisfy the frozen 20-percentage-point criterion without lossy truncation.

source.attribution: publisher-attributed Kimi-K2.5/Hermes execution; not externally authenticated

representation.constructor: actual laya.common.build_sequence imported from the pinned repository-local checkout

question_template.ins: Does the next assistant turn call the {tool} tool?

representation.complete_state_rule: For each budget and all six questions, derive room from the actual upstream empty-state sequence; tokenize complete serialize_state(state), with upstream mask sanitization, truncation=false; reject unless it fits every question; then build all actual upstream sequences and assert exact IDs equal empty-prefix plus every complete state token plus final separator.
state_allowlist: reasoning-stripped immediately previous assistant call value
fixed six availability names and section headings
representation.deduplication: For each budget independently, global exact ordered tuple of six (token-ID tuple, option-marker tuple) pairs in frozen tool order; retain first sorted (trajectory_id, message_index).

fixed_preprocessing.reasoning_stripping: unchanged from exp_001b v0.2.0; reject whole trajectory on malformed or nested think tags
fixed_preprocessing.target_semantics: six-bit exact called-tool set; same-tool multiplicity collapsed; unavailable or malformed calls excluded
fixed_preprocessing.proxy_group: lowercase whitespace-normalized task with numeric and quoted literals replaced

protected_data.rule: Compute proxy group and deterministic split from task text before inspecting tools or conversations. If calibration or test, skip the row before parsing reasoning, prior linkage, or target action. Emit no label-conditioned statistics for protected splits and run no model inference on them.
protected_data.prior_exposure_limitation: exp_001b v0.2.0 previously emitted aggregate calibration/test statistics; exp_001c does not compound that exposure.

linkage_clarification.rule: For an adjacent gpt/tool pair, the presence of either a tool_call wrapper in the gpt value or a tool_response wrapper in the tool value makes it an observation-conditioned candidate. Malformed, incomplete, unparsable, count-mismatched, name-mismatched, or unavailable prior call/result candidates are excluded and counted. The integrity gate requires zero such linkage defects in retained examples; correctly excluded malformed source candidates do not fail the gate.
linkage_clarification.historical_interpretation: exp_001b v0.2.0 remains FAIL because its independent read_file selection-bias failure exceeded the frozen limit; this clarification does not rewrite that result.

metrics_per_budget.pooled: train+development values are descriptive only and cannot override a split failure

integrity: zero residual reasoning markers in retained rows
zero malformed linkage in retained rows
all retained labels use only frozen tools
final exact representations unique after deterministic dedup
no proxy group crosses train/development allocation
data_gates.support: Every tool has at least 10 positive retained trajectories independently in train and development.
data_gates.label_bias: For every tool independently in train and independently in development, absolute positive-versus-negative over-budget-rate difference is <= 0.20.

promotion_rule: Select the smallest budget in [640, 768, 1024] passing every frozen data gate. 512 is reference-only and never promotion-eligible. Do not prefer a larger passing budget. If none passes, select NONE and stop without GPU work.

hardware_smoke.authorization: Only the selected budget may be tested, after data selection.
hardware_smoke.data: synthetic maximum-length noul sequence; no calibration/test data
hardware_smoke.precision: FP16 autocast with GradScaler initial scale 1.0 and FP32 master parameters
hardware_smoke.optimizer: same corrected Phase 1 partition: encoder and scorer optimized; action head excluded
hardware_smoke.bounded_work: exactly one maximum-length sequence forward, backward, and optimizer step; no sustained training
hardware_smoke.pass: No OOM; finite losses and gradients; encoder and scorer update; action head unchanged; peak reserved VRAM <= 11.5 GiB.
hardware_smoke.failure_rule: Classify as HARDWARE FEASIBILITY FAILURE and stop. Do not lower context or promote a different budget.

stop_conditions: source, Laya source, or tokenizer revision/checksum mismatch
no eligible budget passes: record preprocessing remediation FAIL and do not run GPU
selected budget fails hardware: record HARDWARE FEASIBILITY FAILURE and stop
do not train, evaluate, add budgets, change criteria, or begin another experiment
